Declared native snippet/translation programs execute through original widget engines with invocation-owned state and actual native controls. Translation expansion/text replacement uses the native provider context; it is not a React Native or NativeScript VM inside the extension.

Original Expo ActivityKit and original ScriptWidget component/region rendering have native lifecycle integration. Local controls refresh declared activity state with current installation/generation checks.
